question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to display the font dialog box in MS-Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Use the Ctrl+D keyboard shortcut to quickly summon the Font dialog box.
 
• The best benefit of the Font dialog box is its Preview window, at the bottom.
 
• This window shows you exactly how your choices affect text in your document.
 
• The Font names +Body and +Heading refer to the fonts selected by the current document theme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Shortcut keys:
 
 
• Cut the selected content to the Clipboard - Ctrl+X
 
• Copy the selected content to the Clipboard - Ctrl+C
 
• Paste the contents of the Clipboard -Ctrl+V
 
• Increase the font size by 1 point.- Ctrl+]
 
• Center the text - Ctrl+E.
 
• Align the text to the left - Ctrl+L
